tests: A table nested inside a cell of another table, each with its own header row.
attacks: Header inference that treats a table as a flat grid. The inner Day/Session headers belong to the inner table only; promoting them into the outer table's header set, or flattening the two into one grid, invents relationships. Also tests whether a nested table is detected as a table at all.
title: Clinic Staffing Grid

tables.name: outer
tables.headerRelationships: Clinic/Lead/Weekly rota head the outer columns. Ash Road and Beech Lane head the outer rows. Day and Session head NOTHING in the outer table.
